description: Use Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl https://crawler-test.com/. STEPS: 1) Enter 'https://crawler-test.com/' in the URL bar at the top of the application. 2) Click the 'Start' button or press Enter to begin crawling. 3) Wait for the crawl to complete - the status bar at the bottom will show 'Crawl Complete' or the URL count will stop increasing for at least 10 seconds. SUCCESS CRITERIA: The crawl must discover at least 10 URLs from crawler-test.com. The window title should show the crawled URL when complete.
